title: Cloud Classification by Height and Appearance
subject: Geography
description: A hierarchical classification of clouds based on their altitude (High, Middle, Low, Vertically Developed) and appearance, with examples like Cirrus, Cumulus, Stratus, and Cumulonimbus.
mermaidCode:
graph TD
A[Clouds] --> B[High Clouds (>6000m)]
A --> C[Middle Clouds (2000-6000m)]
A --> D[Low Clouds (<2000m)]
A --> E[Vertically Developed Clouds]
B --> B1[Cirrus (Ci)]
B --> B2[Cirrocumulus (Cc)]
B --> B3[Cirrostratus (Cs)]
C --> C1[Altocumulus (Ac)]
C --> C2[Altostratus (As)]
D --> D1[Stratus (St)]
D --> D2[Cumulus (Cu)]
D --> D3[Stratocumulus (Sc)]
D --> D4[Nimbostratus (Ns)]
E --> E1[Cumulonimbus (Cb)]
E --> E2[Cumulus Congestus]
